# CAPABILITY MATRIX - v0.6.0

States: IMPLEMENTED · PARTIAL · EXPERIMENTAL · MOCK · PLANNED · UNAVAILABLE · REQUIRES_CONFIGURATION · REQUIRES_WILCOM · REQUIRES_LICENSED_RESOURCE.
"Tested" = automated tests on **synthetic** artwork generated by this project. No real artwork, sew-out, Wilcom installation, GPU or SAM 2 checkpoint was available.

| Feature | State | Tested | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| PNG / JPG / WEBP / SVG input | IMPLEMENTED | yes | unchanged from v0.5 |
| AI input | PARTIAL | yes | plain PDF-compatible AI only |
| Background excluded by default | IMPLEMENTED | yes | QC rule BACKGROUND_AS_STITCH (ERROR) |
| Hole / counter detection | IMPLEMENTED | yes | glyph counters verified for O A B P R D Q |
| SAM | REQUIRES_CONFIGURATION | no | optional; falls back to classical CV |
| SAM2 | EXPERIMENTAL / REQUIRES_CONFIGURATION | no | never executed in this build |
| Semantic objects | PARTIAL (heuristic) | yes | hierarchy Bird>Head>Eye still PLANNED |
| Circular badge planner | PARTIAL (heuristic) | synthetic | outer border / inner ring / text band / emblem / negative space |
| Parametric circle inference | IMPLEMENTED | yes | Kasa + Gauss-Newton; rejects squares, arcs, solid discs |
| TTF / OTF / TTC vector glyphs (fontTools) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | no fonts bundled; system/user dirs + `EMBCOPILOT_FONT_DIRS` |
| Font browser / scan | IMPLEMENTED | yes | count depends on the machine (the "1000+" target is machine-dependent) |
| SVG fonts | PLANNED | – | |
| Commercial embroidery font libraries | REQUIRES_LICENSED_RESOURCE | – | point the engine at your licensed folder |
| Kerning (GPOS kern, legacy kern) | PARTIAL | yes | pair + class kerning; contextual/mark features not applied |
| Font suitability (stroke, counter, size, self-intersection) | PARTIAL | yes | heuristic thresholds, raster distance transform |
| CurvedTextEngine (arc-length, tangent, 6 modes, sector fit, auto-flip) | IMPLEMENTED | yes + visual check | rigid glyphs or bent (FOLLOW_BASELINE); not yet used by the raster pipeline automatically |
| OCR of text in raster input | PLANNED | – | no OCR engine bundled; user must supply/confirm text |
| Input C / Column C v2 (centerline→rails, variable width) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | angle smoothing, turn limiter, split strategy report |
| Satin ring (parametric) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | v0.5 ring strategy + closed_loop metadata for vector rings |
| Satin splitting | PARTIAL | yes | strategy reported; automatic geometry split PLANNED |
| Tatami v2 (no mesh look) | NOT DONE | – | v0.5 generator unchanged |
| Run / triple run, puff, appliqué, cross, gradient | as v0.5 (PARTIAL) | yes | unvalidated parameters |
| Negative space + protected zones | IMPLEMENTED | yes | enclosed-empty (≥10 mm clear width) and user zones |
| Travel policy (machine/fabric/visibility aware) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | trims vs jumps vs detours; trade-off reported |
| Zone rerouting | PARTIAL | yes | grid A*; unreachable → trim; visibility graph PLANNED |
| Short-stitch classification + cleanup | IMPLEMENTED | yes | duplicate/noise/corner/curve/lock preserved |
| QC v2 (9 categories, 18 rules) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | heuristic thresholds |
| Release gates 1-5 | IMPLEMENTED | yes | gates 6 (export reopen) and 7 (native EMB) are reported per file |
| Export blocking on QC ERROR + logged expert override | IMPLEMENTED | yes | reason required |
| Machine / hoop profiles | IMPLEMENTED (generic presets) | yes | not measurements of a real machine |
| Design diff (OLD/NEW) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | |
| Command parser EN + Hinglish, multi-step | PARTIAL (parse only) | yes | targets validated; executing steps PLANNED |
| Project store `.eacproject`, undo/redo, versions, resume | IMPLEMENTED | yes | |
| Learning (opt-in), SewOutRecord, calibration | IMPLEMENTED | yes | recommends only from the user's own sew-outs |
